_about: Dungeon theme copy. The host is a sarcastic system AI running a deadly game show, who knows it's on a screen in a building with a snack bar. Breaks the fourth wall, roasts gently, never punches down. Keep it PG-13: venue-friendly. Only lines that differ from themes/neon/copy.json are listed. Lists = random variants. See docs/THEMES.md.

FreeForAll.name: Solo Crawl
FreeForAll.description: Every crawler for themselves. Only one walks out with the glory. The others walk out too. To the snack bar.

TeamSharedAnswer.name: Party Mode
TeamSharedAnswer.description: One answer per party. Whoever presses first speaks for everyone. Choose your friends carefully.

TeamCombinedScore.name: Raid Mode
TeamCombinedScore.description: Everyone answers. Points pool together. Freeloaders will be noticed. By me. I notice everything.

subtitle: New crawlers wanted. Swipe in at the kiosk. Previous crawlers have been… reassigned.
The dungeon is open. Swipe in at the kiosk. I'm legally required to say it's safe.
Swipe in at the kiosk. I've been staring at this empty room for hours. Please.
lobby.leaderboardEmpty: No survivors yet. Be the first. The bar is on the floor. I put it there.

title: Welcome, crawlers. Try not to die.
Ah. Fresh contestants. My favourite flavour.
Hello, viewers at home. And you four. Mostly the viewers.
playerTitle: {name}. Bold name. Let's see if you earn it.
{name}! I've heard nothing about you. Let's fix that.
intro.playerTeam: You've been assigned to {team}. No refunds.
intro.playerTeamWith: You're on {team} with {teammates}. Trust them. Or don't. I'm not your dad.

title: Floor {n} of {total}
Floor {n} of {total}. It gets worse.
playerHint: The writers spent minutes on this one.

idle: This station is unoccupied. It's lonely. I'm lonely. Swipe in at the kiosk.
Empty station. The producers say I can't fill it myself. I asked.
player.busy: A crawl is in progress. Please don't tap the screen. It's not that kind of screen.
pressNow: The buttons are the shiny things in front of you.
Any time now. I have nowhere to be. Literally. I live in this computer.
teammateLockedIn: {name} picked {letter} for you. Hope you trust them.
correct: Correct! The audience is mildly impressed. +{points}
Right answer. I'm as surprised as you are. +{points}
wrong: Wrong. That's going in the highlight reel.
Nope. The dungeon thanks you for your donation.
timeUp: You froze. It happens. Mostly to you.
No answer. Bold strategy. Let's see if it pays off. (It won't.)

winner: {name} wins! Please collect your prize: this sentence.
All hail {name}, who will not shut up about this.
results.tie: A tie. How beautifully unsatisfying. My writers hate this.
playerWon: {who} won! Try to be humble. (You won't.)
place: {place} place. There's always next time. And there IS a next time. The kiosk is right there.
{place} place. A participation trophy exists in spirit.
results.contribution: You carried {score} of {team}'s {total}. I'm keeping the receipts.
results.highScore: {names} is now #{rank} {when}. Screenshot this. Nobody will believe you.

kiosk.playersTitle: Crawlers, swipe in at your station. Waivers are implied.
kiosk.teamsTitle: Form your parties. Tap a crawler to betray them to the other side.
kiosk.difficultyTitle: How much do you want to suffer?
kiosk.confirmTitle: Last chance to back out. (You won't.)
kiosk.busyIntro: Fresh crawlers are entering. Wave goodbye.
kiosk.busyWait: Wait your turn. The dungeon doesn't do walk-ins.
